Loss report: gitea -> concourse
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci/trigger/0 trigger.filter.branches (the push trigger has no branch filter, and a git resource follows one branch; the resource follows the default branch of the repository)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci ext.passthrough: git-uri variable (the git resources read their uri from ((git-uri)); set it with fly set-pipeline -v git-uri=<uri> or in the credential manager)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci pipeline.finally: ensure hook on the sink job (the finally jobs run as hooks of the job build, the only job that no other job needs)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/alert job.if: shared shell guard on script tasks; a status function becomes a job hook (on_failure or ensure) (a condition with no guard form leaves the job with no triggering get, so a person starts it, and adds a lost entry)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/alert/step/script ext.passthrough: step name changed (the step ID script is not a Concourse identifier or collides with another step or resource name; the task is script-2)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/alert/step/script step.image: default image (the task names no image, so it runs ubuntu:latest)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/build trigger.push: workspace from the first triggering resource (the tasks run in the checkout of source, and every build uses the newest version of each resource, so a push to source-tags builds the newest commit of source)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/build/step/script step.image: default image (the task names no image, so it runs ubuntu:latest)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/report/step/script ext.passthrough: step name changed (the step ID script is not a Concourse identifier or collides with another step or resource name; the task is script-3)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/report/step/script step.image: default image (the task names no image, so it runs ubuntu:latest)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/trigger/1 trigger.tag: git resource with source.tag_filter (a tag trigger that also has a branch filter is lost, because one git resource cannot hold both sets)
